page_title: RAY 3-3 RMA | Rayo Vallecano v Real Madrid 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Thibaut Courtois to dive and make a save.
90+8' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
90+7' Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul after Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

90+6' Endrick (Real Madrid) peels away from his marker, and leaps high near the penalty spot to meet a cross from the set piece. He tries to put his header into the top left corner, but Augusto Batalla keeps the ball out.
90+5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
90+4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
90+2' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+1' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Endrick (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
89' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

86' A cross by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Madrid.
85' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
85' The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.

84' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Augusto Batalla makes a great save to stop the effort going into the top right corner.
83' The total number of attempts is 13:10. The shots on goal statistics – 4:4.
82' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
81' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
80' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

80' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
79' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Endrick (Real Madrid) replacing Lucas Vazquez.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arda Guler departs the field of play to be replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
77' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
76' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee for shouting at the linesman.
74' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' The substitution has been made. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has replaced Luka Modric.
71' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) touches the ball with his hand.
71' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
69' Half-chance! Luka Modric (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
68' Real Madrid hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
67' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
66' Here's the change. Unai Lopez leaves the pitch and Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
66' Here is a change. Jorge de Frutos is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
64' 3 - 3 Goal! Florian Lejeune takes aim and his effort deflects off Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) to beat the goalkeeper. 3:3.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is replacing Brahim Diaz.
62' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
60' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pathe Ciss is replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
60' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Randy Nteka will be replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
56' 2 - 3 Goal! Arda Guler passes the ball to Rodrygo (Real Madrid) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Augusto Batalla couldn't do anything about it. 2:3.
54' That will be all from Adrian Embarba who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
52' The game is interrupted now, Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
49' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano), but the defence gets it clear.
48' The attendance is 14168.
47' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Rodrygo showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 2:2.
44' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a yellow card.
41' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

39' 2 - 1 Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the bottom left corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.

36' 2 - 0 Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Isi Palazon. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the right post behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:0.
36' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
34' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
34' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
32' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
30' An attempted cross from Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is cleared.
29' The game is interrupted. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
27' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
27' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
26' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
24' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a chip pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois is quickest to intercept the ball.
22' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
21' PENALTY APPEAL after Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

20' A big rebound falls at the feet of Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.
20' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
19' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
17' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
14' Half-chance! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack. Real Madrid get a corner.
13' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
11' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
11' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) dribbles into the box, but Thibaut Courtois is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the corner kick.

4' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Jorge de Frutos finds Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Thibaut Courtois had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
4' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
2' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
2' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Juan Martinez will officiate today.
